facts.fact: Moroccan authorities presented Idarati AI, an assistant designed to guide users through administrative procedures, in September 2026, per Morocco World News.

The customs administration (ADII) and the Korea Customs Service, with Korean firm Okestro, entered the final phase of a project begun May 2026 applying big data and AI to revenue management systems, per an ADII statement.
facts.system: ADII-KCS big data and AI project

facts.fact: Morocco's digital ministry announced in September 2026 the first AI tools from its Mistral AI partnership, a Darija and Arabic dialect identifier and a Darija speech recogniser, and authorities presented a sovereign AI marketplace.
facts.system: Mistral AI partnership tools; sovereign AI marketplace
